title: Virology Capabilities Test (VCT): A Multimodal Virology Q&A Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2504.16137v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We present the Virology Capabilities Test (VCT), a large language model (LLM) benchmark that measures the capability to troubleshoot complex virology laboratory protocols. Constructed from the inputs of dozens of PhD-level expert virologists, VCT consists of $322$ multimodal questions covering fundamental, tacit, and visual knowledge that is essential for practical work in virology laboratories. VCT is difficult: expert virologists with access to the internet score an average of $22.1\%$ on questions specifically in their sub-areas of expertise. However, the most performant LLM, OpenAI's o3, reaches $43.8\%$ accuracy, outperforming $94\%$ of expert virologists even within their sub-areas of specialization. The ability to provide expert-level virology troubleshooting is inherently dual-use: it is useful for beneficial research, but it can also be misused. translated_title: 病毒学能力测试（VCT）：一个多模态病毒学问答基准
translated_abstract: 我们提出了病毒学能力测试（VCT），这是一个用于衡量大型语言模型（LLM）解决复杂病毒学实验室操作方案问题能力的基准。VCT由数十位博士级专家病毒学家提供输入构建而成，包含322个多模态问题，涵盖了病毒学实验室实际工作中必需的基础知识、隐性知识和视觉知识。VCT难度很高：即使是能够使用互联网的专家病毒学家，在其专业子领域内的特定问题上平均得分也仅为22.1%。然而，表现最强的LLM——OpenAI的o3——达到了43.8%的准确率，即便在专家的细分专业领域内，也超过了94%的专家病毒学家。提供专家级病毒学故障排除能力本质上是双用途的：它对有益的研究有用，但也可能被滥用。因此，公开可用的模型表现优于病毒学家这一事实……
tldr: 研究者提出了由博士级病毒学专家构建的322题多模态基准VCT，结果显示OpenAI的o3以43.8%的准确率超过94%的专家病毒学家，凸显了AI在病毒学领域的能力及其双用途风险。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces VCT, a 322-question multimodal virology benchmark built by PhD-level experts, showing that OpenAI's o3 (43.8% accuracy) outperforms 94% of expert virologists, highlighting AI's advanced virology capabilities and dual-use concerns.
